mc.name: Luna
mc.why: highest and widest pitch of the 6 auditioned (F0 321 Hz, 239-422), brightest timbre; the 0.9 Japanese MC was the highest voice

rin.name: Sienna
rin.base: Calm, cool adult woman, dry irony.
rin.why: lowest, darkest of the 5 (F0 171 Hz); the 0.9 Rin had the darkest timbre; least similar to Hana and Nova

hana.name: Remy
hana.why: fast and clear (14.7 chars/s, F0 230 Hz), most distinct from Rin (speaker similarity 0.55)

yue.name: Naomi
yue.base: Regal adult woman, low velvety voice.
yue.why: darkest timbre of the 6 (centroid 1181 Hz), velvety; clean ASR

nova.name: Marisol
nova.base: Crisp, ironic adult woman, slightly husky.
nova.why: husky mid voice (F0 191 Hz), least similar to Rin (0.54) and Yue (0.60)
